column1: # config/levers.tsv -- lever registry for tools/codegen_map.py (T2, Phase 1.7). One row per byte-proven lever, TAB-separated.
# group: expand-cse|loop|combine|regalloc|sched-reorg (gcc 2.95.2 pass groups). tell: the residual the lever moves. label: expected
# plateau class of `before` (tools/plateau.py vocabulary; checked by plateau.py --check). alias/start/end: the game fn, hex, end exclusive. before_c/after_c: our C under tools/probes/levers/,
# self-contained, defining func_<START>. cookbook: C<nnnn>. Checked by `tools/codegen_map.py --check`; docs/codegen-map.md is
# generated from this file by `tools/codegen_map.py --write`. No game bytes or asm here (G12).

column3: andi-before-srl vs srl-before-andi on a byte field

if/else arms in swapped order: early-return arm at fallthrough vs at the branch target (same insns)
narrowed-param andi+addiu sunk below the constant loads vs leading the fn (same insns, reordered)
addu operand order in a scaled-index address: index,base vs base,index (same insns)
